notes.MPW|Total revenue: 10-K revenue table. FY2023 is net of ~$459M reserves (mostly Steward) booked as negative revenue; FY2023 straight-line rent revenue was -$127.9M.
notes.MPW|Straight-line rent adjustment (non-c: CFS line 'Straight-line rent revenue and other' (latest 10-K presentation).
notes.MPW|Loans to tenants (mortgage and other: Mortgage loans + Other loans (BS) + loan-type investments in unconsolidated operating entities (Steward loan, Springstone/Lifepoint loan, Priory term loan, international JV loan) per Note 3 tables. Excludes $1.06-2.05B of financing-lease receivables that share the same CECL allowance.
notes.MPW|Allowance for credit losses on loans: Note 2 CECL rollforward: covers financing leases AND loans. Provision: 41.7 / 99.0 / 10.2 / 1,241.0; FY2024 write-offs against allowance 825.5.
notes.MPW|Straight-line rent / receivable writ: CFS 'Straight-line rent and other write-off'. FY2022 excludes ~$125M SL write-off netted inside the Macquarie sale gain. FY2023 = ~$95M Utah SL write-off + Q4 Steward reserves ($154M billed rent, $224M SL rent, $35M interest) + other tenants (~$95M).
notes.MPW|Revenue from largest single tenant: Steward. MPW did NOT disclose a dollar or % figure in the FY2021-FY2023 10-Ks (only '>10% of revenue' and share of total assets: 25.1% / 24.2% / 19.2%). FY2022 figure ($427.9M, 27.7%) first disclosed in FY2024 10-K. FY2024 largest = Circle ($205.6M, 20.7%).
notes.MPW|Impairment charges (real estate and: IS 'Real estate and other impairment charges, net'. FY2024 excludes a further $410.8M equity-interest real estate impairment in the equity-interest line.
notes.OHI|Total equity: Total incl. noncontrolling interest (~5% of total). Parent-only: 3,906.8 / 3,609.4 / 3,574.6 / 4,536.7.
notes.OHI|Straight-line rent adjustment (non-c: CFS 'Straight-line rent and effective interest receivables' (FY2023/FY2024 10-K presentation).
notes.OHI|Total debt (sum of all borrowings): Revolver + secured borrowings + senior notes & other unsecured (net).
notes.OHI|Loans to tenants (mortgage and other: Net: mortgage notes + other real estate loans + non-real-estate loans (Note 13). FY2021 = mortgage 835.1 + other investments 469.9.
notes.OHI|Allowance for credit losses on loans: Note 7 CECL rollforward total (real estate loans, non-RE loans, DFL). Provision 76.7 / 68.7 / 45.6 / (10.0).
notes.OHI|Straight-line rent / receivable writ: Note 5: SL + lease-inducement write-offs on cash-basis moves (36.0 / 119.8) + operator transitions (1.3 / 3.2); FY2023-24 incl. effective-yield interest write-offs.
notes.OHI|Revenue from largest single tenant: Implied $ from disclosed %: Consulate/LaVie 9.5% (FY21), LaVie 11.1% (FY22), CommuniCare 11.5% (FY23), CommuniCare 11.8% (FY24). FY21-23 % are 'excluding the impact of write-offs'.
notes.SBRA|Total revenue: Includes resident fees & services (managed senior housing): 155.5 / 186.7 / 236.2 / 284.6. Comparable (rental + interest) revenue: 414.0 / 438.2 / 411.4 / 418.7.
notes.SBRA|Straight-line rent adjustment (non-: CFS 'Non-cash rental and related revenues' (SL rent + intangible amortization + write-offs; positive = write-offs exceeded accrual).
notes.SBRA|Straight-line rent receivable (bala: Not disclosed as a standalone balance (inside 'accounts receivable, prepaid expenses and other assets').
notes.SBRA|Straight-line rent / receivable wri: FY2021 Avamere $25.2M ($44.0M incl. above-market intangible); FY2022 North American $15.6M ($17.1M total). None disclosed FY2023-24.
notes.SBRA|Revenue from largest single tenant: Not disclosed: 'no tenant relationship represented 10% or more of total revenues' in every year.
notes.SBRA|Income (loss) from unconsolidated j: IS line incl. Enlivant JV other-than-temporary impairments of $164.1M (FY21) and $57.8M (FY22).
notes.OHI|Real estate loans interest income: FY2024 10-K consolidated statements of operations (FY2022-FY2024). FY2021 not collected: it falls outside the three years presented in that filing.
notes.OHI|Non-real estate loans interest incom: FY2024 10-K consolidated statements of operations (FY2022-FY2024). FY2021 not collected: it falls outside the three years presented in that filing.
notes.OHI|Miscellaneous income: FY2024 10-K consolidated statements of operations (FY2022-FY2024). FY2021 not collected: it falls outside the three years presented in that filing.
notes.MPW|Largest tenant share of total assets: Share of total assets per the 10-K concentration disclosures (FY2021-FY2023). No FY2024 figure in the data set.
notes.MPW|Investment in loans receivable (CFS): Consolidated statements of cash flows, investing activities, 'Investment in loans receivable': FY2021 from the FY2022 10-K (58,932), FY2022-FY2024 from the FY2024 10-K (207,542 / 250,223 / 420,324), $ thousands. Cash advanced on loans to all borrowers, not only rent-paying tenants.
notes.MPW|Principal received on loans receivab: Consolidated statements of cash flows, investing activities, 'Principal received on loans receivable' (FY2024 10-K label: 'Principal received from sale and repayment of loans receivable'): FY2021 from the FY2022 10-K (1,595,708), FY2022-FY2024 from the FY2024 10-K (53,322 / 501,630 / 214,416), $ thousands.
